estimates.name: Net Realizable Value of RhodoLED ® XL Inventory
estimates.t: Net realizable value is estimated as the expected selling price of the RhodoLED ® XL-C, less the estimated costs to complete the lamps, including absorbed production overhead, and the costs to deliver and install them.
